decision: No new numerical stage or standalone-paper advance is justified by these three finite source gates.
actual_scope: Three genuinely distinct frozen frontier gates challenged once: imaging diagnostic rule, native non-RNA metabolic/function and ordinary protein measurement. No new tasks, target ranking, outcome mining or recurrent whole-paper review.
most_material_distinctions: The imaging rule already qualifies the proposed low-uptake/myxoid exception; inventing a universal benignity promise would manufacture a negative paper.
The generic NMR chondrosarcoma remains eligible-pending, not authenticated EMC; steady-state abundance is not enzyme activity.
CAM parent models are explicitly non-EMC, while the matched-MS actual EMC cohort/release remains unknown. Global model-fidelity prior art does not veto every possible useful EMC-specific contrast.
concrete_current_action: Integrate the source/claim dispositions; do not execute numeric extraction or manuscript work from these gates. Move to a genuinely different authenticated opportunity, or reopen a specific gate only when its named primary source/identity/control/input gap is resolved and a fixed useful question survives. No unchanged failed-route retry or invented negative paper.
all_public_coverage: All generic, inaccessible, suitable pending, contrary, control and repeated-condition statuses remain as in the exact owning ledgers. This is not comprehensive evaluation of every source, absence of EMC measurements or campaign exhaustion.
old_results: Original R1-R9 and GPNMB/other source/numeric freezes are unchanged. GPNMB remains held, TMEM266 shelved.
source_only_limits: Owner exposure/repair records remain visible; no fully blinded or zero historical exposure claim. Closed endpoint projections, primary full bodies, raw matrices, denied scientific content and medical images were not opened in this review.
